Shishiku"NOT BAD? YOUR STUPIDITY HAS NO BLOODY CEILING!!"
Doushin"Now, now. Both of you, naming is also very fine. First let us dispose of the matters immediately before us, shall we?"
Chachamaru"We had matters?"
Shishiku"...Too many. Are you understanding the situation at all?"
Chachamaru"Probably. Old man dead, shogunate in danger of collapse."
Chachamaru"Arre? Sounds a bit serious, no?"
Doushin"Indeed. Quite serious it is. Fwah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!"
Shishiku"Now you are noticing?! And Doushin, why are you laughing as if somebody else's government is collapsing?"
Chachamaru"Mazak tha, yaar. Don't swallow it whole. Anyway, Raichou? That Hachimangu investigation, what happened?"
Raichou"...No progress. Darkness from every direction. What happened there, nobody knows."
Shishiku"Hmph. Leave it. His Highness is dead; that is no longer in doubt. Beside that fact, the details are small change."
Doushin"Quite so. How we respond to that fact is the present business."
Raichou"Yes... First, a magnificent state funeral. Father conquered all under heaven. His funeral must be worthy of him. We must approach the court, secure attendance from the imperial family..."

Shishiku"Idiot. None of that matters."
Raichou"None of it MATTERS? It is Father's funeral!"
Shishiku"And? Burn a body, bury it. That is all. Actually, even that labour is unnecessary."
Chachamaru"Body itself is not there, na."
Raichou"Y-you disrespectful swine! Zubaan sambhaalo! The same mouth swore loyalty to Father, and now it produces THIS?"
Shishiku"My loyalty was to the living Lord General. Not the dead one."
Shishiku"Why waste time on something of no use? We are in an emergency."
Raichou"S-something of no USE...? You... even this far—!"
Doushin"Now, now. Raichou..."
Raichou"Reverend Doushin, you HEARD him! How much must one overlook as the barking of an under-retainer promoted beyond his manners? There is a limit!"
Raichou"Father is gone, so his filthy nature comes out without even a covering! I knew what was underneath. Knowing and having it displayed in one's face are different things!"
Shishiku"Hmph. Bark away. Your assessment of my character interests me not at all."
Shishiku"I do what I must. Whoever obstructs me, I remove. Raichou, if you intend more than barking, that overdressed neck is first onto my spear."
Raichou"...!!"
Shishiku"Not that I expect it. The second son who somehow failed to become his father's heir. Had you even a scrap of guts, would you have accepted that position?"

Doushin"Very good. The council may continue."
Chachamaru"Arre, now the old man's suffering is becoming clear. How did he keep this circus together? Only after someone goes do you appreciate the fellow's real value."
Chachamaru"Choked with remembrance, Chachamaru Ashikaga surrendered to her emotions and devoured castella. Aansu nahin, cake. Thus did she mourn."
Raichou"Do not replace tears with cake..."
Doushin"...Now. His Highness's funeral is naturally important. The whole Rokuhara house's standing is involved."
Shishiku"I do not deny that, but—"
Raichou"Then shut up, you jumped-up nobody. Reverend Doushin understands propriety. Unlike certain newly elevated specimens."
Doushin"Now, now, Raichou. The end of my sentence also wishes to be heard."
Doushin"The funeral is important, yes. But importance has its weights. Or, if you prefer, its order of attendance."
Raichou"Order?"
Doushin"Consider it. A state funeral requires vast money and manpower. In our present condition, what follows if we commit both?"
Doushin"Regrettably, the shogunate is unsteady on its feet. GHQ, our great enemy, and the rebels hiding across the country are watching that wobble with hungry eyes. Of this there is no doubt."
Raichou"But even then...!"
Doushin"Of course. Your distress, I understand. A son made to postpone his father's funeral—where is he to put his face? But if peace for His Highness's spirit is truly our concern..."
Doushin"First tighten the shogunate's loose hoops. Restore its order under Kuniuji. Would His Highness not rest easier then? What do you say?"
Raichou"..."
Doushin"Let us move the court to proclaim Kuniuji Lord General without delay. Afterward, the state funeral can be held in the new Lord General's name."
Chachamaru"Haan. No objection."
Shishiku"The obvious course. A working brain would have arrived there."
Raichou"Ngh..."
Doushin"Raichou."
Raichou"...I-I have no objection. Certainly... that would be safer."
Raichou"Perhaps I was a little hasty. ...Forgive me, Reverend Doushin."
Doushin"No, no. Any dutiful child wishes to mourn his father promptly. This monk brings political calculation and stands in the way of filial devotion. The shame belongs on my head."
Raichou"No..."
Chachamaru"Bad luck, Hideyoshi bhai. Daitokuji can wait. Nobunaga and Hidekatsu are not going anywhere."
Raichou"!! I-I have no idea what you mean."
Shishiku"...Hmph."

童心「ここはまず、幕府の緩んだ箍たがを締め直し、 邦氏公のもと体制を再建してこそ、草葉の陰 で殿もご安堵なさるのではあるまいか……。 　如何かな」

獅子吼「それが当然の筋書きだな。 　馬鹿でなければ誰もがそう考えるだろう」
雷蝶「うぐ……」
童心「雷蝶殿」
雷蝶「……い……異存はありません。 　確かに……その方が無難でしょうから」

雷蝶「!! 　な、何を言っているのかわからないわね」
獅子吼「……ふっ」

雷蝶「……そうね」

Shishiku"We cannot sit here at Fudaraku forever, all our heads lined up. Lose our own footing and we lose everything. Each must return to his administration and settle the disorder in his district."
Chachamaru"Suspicious fellows scurrying everywhere, looks like. Something will catch fire soon, no?"
Doushin"We must act before that. But leaving Kuniuji alone in this castle is also not possible..."
Shishiku"Indeed. Before three days are out, the rebels would be serving his head at their feast."
Chachamaru"Call Yukitsura from Dazaifu?"
Raichou"Please do not talk rubbish."
Doushin"Doggy, doggy, aao, food is waiting... He would come most happily."
Shishiku"With his army. Then Kanto hosts our decisive battle against him."
Chachamaru"Sounds entertaining."
Raichou"Entertainment is not the selection criterion! That fellow is a textbook parasite eating us from inside. No need to invite him. One of us can stay."
Doushin"Quite reasonable. Who shall take the duty?"
Raichou"...My own Oyumi district worries me too, naturally. But I am Kuniuji's uncle."
Raichou"His closest blood relation. My presence will reassure him more than anybody else's."
Doushin"...Indeed, indeed. Surely so."

茶々丸「あっちこっちでキナ臭い連中がちょこまか してるみたいだかんなー。 　そろそろどっかで火がつくか？」
童心「そうなる前に手を打たねばいかんのう。 　だがさて、この城に邦氏公をひとり残して ゆくわけにもいかぬし……」
獅子吼「ああ。 　そんな真似をすれば、邦氏公の首は三日と 経たず倒幕派どもの宴へ供されることになる だろうよ」
茶々丸「大宰府の幸行ユキツラでも呼ぶ？」
雷蝶「馬鹿言わないで頂戴」
童心「犬さん犬さん、餌をやるからおいでなさい、 てか……喜んで来るだろうの」
獅子吼「軍を率いてな。 　関東を舞台に、我々と奴で決戦だ……」
茶々丸「面白いじゃん？」
雷蝶「面白さで選ぶなっつーの。 　あんな獅子身中の虫の標本みたいなやつを 呼ばなくたって、麿たちのうち一人が残れば 済むことでしょう」
童心「ふむう、ご尤もでござる。 　して、誰がその任を負うべきですかな？」
雷蝶「……麿とて軍管区おゆみの情勢が気にならないと 言えば嘘になります。 　けれど、麿は邦氏にとっては叔父」
雷蝶「一番近い肉親です。 　他の誰が残るより、麿が残る方が、邦氏を 安心させてやれるでしょう」
童心「……成程、成程。 　如何にも、左様でござりましょうなァ」

Doushin"Tell me your honest view. If you are displeased—and naturally you would be—I shall apologise to them both and have the proposal withdrawn...?"
